implementation_limit: These examples concern the inspected public source only; the historical code used for paper experiments has not been established, so they do not invalidate reported paper results.
transfer_constraints: Use one consistent coordinate system and correct IoU/GIoU arithmetic.
Answer invariance alone does not prove semantic correctness; whole-image/constant-box degeneracy remains possible.
Blurring an object does not guarantee that its colour, position, or presence becomes false; do not use all ghosted inputs as semanticNo.
A crop can destroy relative-position or motion context; preserve the task when using privileged views.
Use a proper distributional divergence and actual multimodal prompt boundary for teacher adapter learning.
Preserve T0 reference and give same observations to all KD controls; verify teacher and RMOT task outcomes after output sealing.
